name: Okutama (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Okutama town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top above a crown-like base, enclosing a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Okutama, a town in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1975; the emblem dates from 1 April 1960.

features.role: Okutama town emblem — a ring with a pointed top above a crown-like base, enclosing a small ring
